scenes.text: Humans have wiped out only one human disease in history: smallpox.
The last natural case was a hospital cook in Merca, Somalia, named Ali Maow Maalin.
His rash appeared on October twenty sixth, nineteen seventy seven.
Health workers traced and vaccinated everyone around him, and he recovered.
Exactly two years later, experts for the World Health Organization certified that smallpox had been eradicated.
Maalin later spent years volunteering to help end polio in Somalia.
Which disease do you think humans will beat next?

title: The last person to catch smallpox naturally 💉
caption: On 26 October 1977, Ali Maow Maalin in Merca, Somalia became the last natural smallpox case. Exactly 2 years later, WHO experts certified smallpox eradicated, the only human disease ever wiped out. 💉
